name: py-parse-duration
prompt: parse_duration in timeutil/duration.py only understands a single unit ("90s", "5m"). Make it accept a sequence of number+unit parts such as "1h30m", "2d 4h" or "1h 0m 15s" (spaces between parts are allowed) with the units d, h, m, s and ms, and return the total as a float number of seconds. Numbers may be decimal ("1.5h"). An empty string, an unknown unit, a part without a unit, or the same unit twice must raise ValueError. The existing tests are in tests/.
